settings.label: API key
settings.meaning: Acts as the Cal.com user who made it: reads their event types and availability, and makes and manages their bookings and webhooks.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Developer › API keys › New. Cal.com's docs describe test keys starting cal_ and live keys starting cal_live_, but the dashboard makes no test keys, so the prefix tells nothing and no check is made: use a separate Cal.com account for test.

settings.label: Webhook secret
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Cal.com. You choose it, and it's given to Cal.com when the webhook is made.
settings.whereToFind: Any long random string of your own: webhooks.create sends it to Cal.com. For a webhook made in Settings › Developer › Webhooks, the secret entered there.

settings.label: API address
settings.meaning: Where API v2 is served. Only for a self-hosted Cal.com.
settings.whereToFind: Your instance's API v2 address, the one that stands for https://api.cal.com/v2; leave it unset for Cal.com's own cloud.

operations.name: me.get
operations.purpose: Reads the user the API key belongs to: their username (for booking links), email and time zone.

operations.name: eventTypes.list
operations.purpose: Lists the user's event types, or another user's public ones by username (cal-api-version 2026-06-12).

operations.name: eventTypes.get
operations.purpose: Reads one event type by its id: its slug, length, booking fields and booking page URL (cal-api-version 2026-06-12).

operations.name: slots.list
operations.purpose: Lists an event type's free slots between two times, by date, in a time zone (cal-api-version 2024-09-04, format=range).

operations.name: bookings.create
operations.purpose: Books an event type at a start time in UTC for an attendee. Cal.com takes no idempotency key, so it is never retried after an outage (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: bookings.get
operations.purpose: Reads one booking by its uid (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: bookings.list
operations.purpose: Lists the user's bookings, a page at a time by cursor, filtered by status, attendee, event type and time (cal-api-version 2026-05-01).

operations.name: bookings.cancel
operations.purpose: Cancels a booking, optionally with a reason (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: bookings.reschedule
operations.purpose: Moves a booking to a new start time: Cal.com makes a new booking and cancels the old one (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: bookings.confirm
operations.purpose: Accepts a booking of an event type that requires confirmation (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: bookings.decline
operations.purpose: Declines a booking of an event type that requires confirmation, optionally with a reason (cal-api-version 2026-02-25).

operations.name: webhooks.create
operations.purpose: Makes a webhook for the user's bookings, signed with the webhook secret.

operations.name: webhooks.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes one of the user's webhooks by its id.

signature.description: The header is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the webhook's secret, with no prefix. A webhook made without a secret sends the text no-secret-provided instead: refuse it. No delivery id is signed.

events.meaning: A booking was made, or a booking that needed confirmation was accepted.
A booking was made that waits for the host to confirm it.
A booking moved: payload.uid is the new booking, payload.rescheduleUid the old one.
A booking was cancelled.
The host declined a booking that needed confirmation.
The booker started paying for a paid event type.
A paid booking was paid for.
A host or attendee was marked absent, or no longer absent.
A booking's location changed; payload.previousLocation holds the old one.
A booking's title changed in the organizer's calendar and was synced.
A round-robin booking moved to another host.
The host accepted a seat on a seated booking that needs confirmation.
The host rejected a seat on a seated booking that needs confirmation.
A booking's start time came. Its body is flat: the booking's fields sit beside triggerEvent, with no payload.
A booking's end time came. Its body is flat: the booking's fields sit beside triggerEvent, with no payload.
A Cal Video recording of a booking can be downloaded.
A Cal Video recording's transcript can be downloaded.
An instant meeting was requested.
A host accepted an instant meeting.
The user added an out-of-office entry.
Someone submitted one of the user's routing forms.
A routing form was submitted and no booking followed within 15 minutes.
